name: Sinter
source:
It's the year 2060. 

Riley is a striped hyena who has spent a long time waiting for their chance to put their marine biology studies to use professionally. Their application was selected for a new fringe science project at the bottom of the sea aboard the ThermalGenesis Research Platform.

All is not as it seems, however, as Riley's draw towards the ocean goes much deeper than simple fascination and career choices...

Whose voice is calling you?

[From [url=https://albawuff.itch.io/sinter]Itch.io[/url]]
